title: Intersection of neighboring block intervals
statement: For every natural number $N$ and integers $p,q$ with $|p-q|\le 1$, the intervals from $(N+1)p$ through $(N+1)p+N+1$ and from $(N+1)q$ through $(N+1)q+N+1$, inclusive, have nonempty intersection.
